## What's Changed
* Add idempotency support via optional idempotency_key

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pgr0ss/pgledger/compare/v0.8.0...v0.9.0

## What's Changed
* `pgledger_create_transfer(s)` now rejects bad input with clearer errors
* Add tighter amount validations, handling `NULL`, `NaN`, `Infinity`, and `-Infinity`
* Add a property-based test suite (using [Hegel](https://hegel.dev/)) to further validate ledger correctness

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pgr0ss/pgledger/compare/v0.7.0...v0.8.0

Jobs run on BullMQ when `REDIS_URL` is set, and on an in-memory queue when it is not. Redis also backs API-key rate limits and the media cache, each with an in-memory fallback.
- Docker Compose brings up the API, Postgres, and Redis. Optional profiles cover MinIO and bgutil.
